archfiend.settings.title: Archfiend Settings
archfiend.settings.enabled.tooltip: Play a 3D chest sequence when an RNG drop is announced in chat.
archfiend.settings.style.tooltip:
Treasure Chest: a 3D chest drops into the GUI, bursts open and reveals the item.
World Chest: the chest is a real object that drops into the world and lands with physics before bursting open.
archfiend.settings.min_tier.tooltip: Lowest drop tier that triggers a sequence. Lower tiers are shown in chat as normal.
archfiend.settings.delay_chat.tooltip: Hold the drop message back until the sequence reveals the item, so chat can't spoil the result.
archfiend.settings.spin.tooltip: How long the chest sequence plays before opening.
archfiend.settings.reveal.tooltip: How long the result stays on screen after landing.
archfiend.settings.scale.tooltip: Size of the chest. It also adapts to your GUI scale automatically.
archfiend.settings.volume.tooltip: Volume of the sequence sounds and reveal fanfare.
archfiend.settings.hide_hud.tooltip: Hide the hotbar, health, scoreboard, chat and your hand while a sequence plays, so nothing distracts from (or spoils) the reveal.
archfiend.settings.repo_enabled.tooltip: Download the NotEnoughUpdates item repo for real SkyBlock icons and item models.
archfiend.settings.repo_auto_update.tool: Check GitHub for a newer repo version every time the game starts.
archfiend.settings.repo_update.tooltip: Click to download the latest version now.
archfiend.settings.preview.tooltip: Close this screen and play a test sequence for your Min Tier. Only available in a world.
